body:
# Description

A mod pack full of good vibes without being overwhelming. Much of it can be safely ignored if you want a more relaxing experience, but there's plenty to explore if you feel like digging deeper!

This pack adds:
- 🚂 Automation via **Create** and its various expansions.
- 🌽 Cozier farming with **Farmer's Delight**.
- 💾 Thinking machines via **CC: Tweaked**.
- 📦 Storage via **Applied Energistics 2**.
- 🔚 Major improvements to the End with **Enderscape**.
- ✨ Small cozy additions like **Supplementaries**, **Exposure**, **Critters and Companions**, and more.
- 🏔️ A horizon you can actually see via **Distant Horizons**.
- 🌟 Shaders via **Complementary Shaders - Reimagined**, with patches.
- 📈 Image upscaling (FSR/DLSS/XeSS/SGSR) via **Super Resolution**.
- ↩️ Backported features from newer Minecraft versions.
- 😎 Engine improvements and optimizations.
- 🗺️ Various quality of life improvements.
- And more!

Compatiblity mods have also been included to help everything play nicer together, such as bridging functionality between mods and cleaning up duplicate recipes.

This pack does not include any custom content. All included mods are property of their respective authors.

## Terrain Generation

This pack does affect world generation, so keep that in mind if adding it to an existing world.

- The Overworld now includes backported features such as the Pale Garden biome. Villages have new farms and various structurs have been added. The overall shape of the terrain, however, remains largely the same.
- The End has been heavily overhauled with new new biomes and structures.
- The Nether is largely unaffected.

# Incentive

I created this pack because I couldn't quite find one that had everything I wanted. Many modpacks are incredibly feature-rich or focus heavily on one area, such as tech or magic, often overhauling Minecraft's core gameplay. I wanted something that still felt like vanilla Minecraft while giving me the freedom to explore popular mods at my own pace and on my own terms.

# Support

I do not provide support for this pack, and I probably will not be much help with debugging issues anyway.

If you experience an issue, please try to verify that does not come from the modpack itself before reaching out to individual mod authors for support.
